name: check7_flux3_klein_synthetic_512

inputs.features: seeded normal, std 4.0, rounded to bf16
inputs.matmul_bf16: bf16 operands, float32 GEMM, one bf16 rounding
inputs.timestep: bf16 as the reference pipeline packs it, in both modes
inputs.lora_source: synthetic, seed 7, gain 1.0, ranks 4 to 16, alpha half the rank
inputs.application: unmerged: strength * (alpha / rank) * up(down(x)) added to each target's output in the mode's dtype

exact_free_floor.measured: gmlx's exact step on the GPU against the same step on the CPU stream, worst free row; tests/image/flux3_gates.py exact_free_floor on flux3-klein, Apple M5 Max

exact_velocity_floor.measured: gmlx's exact step on the GPU against the same step on the CPU stream, velocity; tests/image/flux3_gates.py exact_free_floor on flux3-klein, Apple M5 Max

tolerances.rule: tolerance = 2 x the oracle's own bf16 against fp32 relative L2: teacher-forced for each block and the final layer, free running for the time vectors, modulations and embeddings and for the velocity

notes: the adapter is applied unmerged as PEFT applies it; the gmlx side runs it under a patch table
